values.note: Reservable online up to 365 days ahead and for the same day ('Reservations can be made for today'), or at 1-888-432-2267. No check-in for reserved sites: set up any time after 3 p.m. The 14-night limit is cumulative: 14 nights in any 21 days across Maryland state park campgrounds, then seven nights away.

booking.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/martinak-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380117 (Booking Window, Campsite Electric/Non-Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 365 Day(s) in advance.') + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/Martinak/Camping.aspx ('If you have a camping reservation, there is no need to "check-in" -- simply proceed to your designated campsite/mini-cabin and set up anytime after 3:00 p.m.'; 'limited to 14 cumulative nights of camping in Maryland State Park campgrounds during any 21-day period'; 'Call 1-888-432-CAMP (2267)'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/Martinak/Camping.aspx ('thirty of which feature electric hook-ups'; 'No water hook-ups are available, but potable water is conveniently located around each loop.') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/martinak-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380117 (per-site details: 2 Acorn Loop electric sites 'Electrical Service (amp): 50', 27 Butterfly Loop sites 30), read 2026-10-21

values.note: DNR: 'Sixty-three campsites are available for trailer or tent camping, thirty of which feature electric hook-ups.' The booking site lists 59 (29 electric, mostly in Butterfly Loop; 30 non-electric, mostly Acorn Loop), with vehicle lengths of 40-76 ft.

summary: Confirmed fees ($18.50 / $24.50 electric on oc.aspx), reservable 365 days ahead incl. same day. Added 50-amp at 2 sites (30 elsewhere), no water hookups, 63 sites to 76 ft, showers, water spigots, dump (closed for replacement now), 14-in-21-night limit. Not stated on the park's pages: a minimum stay (left inherited), walk-ups (fcfs left inherited). Note kept.
flags: Season (manual, not overwritten): the entry is an approximate March 20 - October 31; the booking site's 2026 dates are 'All Campsites: March 27, 2026-November 1, 2026' (2027: March 26 - October 31), DNR's camping page 'generally open Spring (late March) through Fall (end of October)'.

Fees (not overwritten): the booking site's Facility Rates table shows 'Campsite Non-Electric $19.50-$20.50 / Campsite Electric $25.50-$26.50' for the 2026 and 2027 peak seasons, $1 above DNR's $18.50/$24.50, with the footnote 'Displayed rates are base rates and do not reflect discounts, surcharges (holiday/weekend/residency)'. The fee note's 'no out-of-state camping surcharge' is unconfirmed (Elk Neck's DNR page states a $1/night non-Maryland charge).
Phone: entry has none; DNR gives 'Contact: 410-820-1668' (https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/martinak.aspx).
Website: the entry's website is the booking page only; DNR's camping page is https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/Martinak/Camping.aspx.
